blocking_findings.contract_source: Authoritative plan Sections 5, 6, 8 and 11; Milestone 2 T4 and Milestone 3 T6; FINAL-F007 verification contract
blocking_findings.exact_requirement: Every non-user replan, including historical entries, must resolve only an exact code-appropriate host-produced Sol or Hermes artifact bound to its contemporaneous run, plan, request, base, candidate and freshness identities; fabricated or internally rehashed substitutions must be rejected without Astra invocation.
blocking_findings.concrete_evidence: lib/hermes_factory_v2.py:6963-6966 validates historical Hermes base_commit and candidate_id only by type/hex shape; it does not bind either value to an immutable contemporaneous snapshot, candidate artifact, completed-commit lineage or trigger phase. The independent end-to-end probe replaced a historical candidate value of null with ffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffff and its real base with forty zeroes, rehashed all mutable evidence/history references, and status() accepted the completed run. Additionally, the historical Sol branch validates the referenced request digest but does not require the historical plan's request_ref to equal evidence.request_ref.
blocking_findings.observed_state: A fabricated, internally rehashed historical Hermes record with false but well-formed base and candidate identities remains authoritative and passes terminal status validation. Historical Sol plan/request pairing is also not explicitly enforced.
blocking_findings.expected_state: Each historical trigger must be checked against an immutable contemporaneous transition snapshot or equivalent host lineage proving the exact plan, request, base and candidate present when the trigger was reserved. Historical Sol validation must also require plan.request_ref to equal the validated evidence request_ref.
blocking_findings.why_it_blocks_current_step: Replan history can authorize and preserve an Astra strategy transition without proving which base/candidate and request-plan pair actually produced the trigger, violating required durable provenance and fail-closed resume/terminal correctness.
blocking_findings.required_correction: Persist and validate an immutable contemporaneous identity for every replan record, binding historical Hermes base and candidate—including required null values—to the actual trigger state and candidate/commit lineage. In the historical Sol branch, enforce plan.request_ref == evidence.request_ref and exact request-artifact validation. Add internally rehashed base-only, candidate-only and plan/request-pair substitutions through execute, resume and status, asserting rejection and zero new Astra or Luna calls.

resolved_findings.evidence: Original Runner-result digest and canonical attestation are now preserved and revalidated before Sol, commit and terminal acceptance. Independent pre-attestation result and log mutations reached neither Sol nor commit.

next_actions: Repair FINAL-F007 by binding every historical replan record to its immutable contemporaneous base/candidate and plan/request identities, then rerun the targeted internally rehashed mutation matrix through execute, resume and status.
